titleAngles.myth: Constant internal thinking means you are deeply analyzing and solving life problems

titleAngles.myth: You must passively wait for mental clarity and peaceful thoughts before taking action

chapters.title: Living in the Work, Not Narrative

description: In Think Straight by Darius Foroux, we explore why drowning in involuntary chatter is not genuine thinking. We examine why being a passenger in your skull sabotages action and how William James's radical pragmatism helps filter mental clutter into clear decisive execution.
